figures.caption: A balanced ring computes SUM by reduce-scatter, then replicates the reduced shards by all-gather. Scope: illustrative four-rank FP16 inputs; phase-boundary states, not a complete timing trace. The small integer values and their sums are exactly representable. Each phase sends and receives 6 B per rank; both phases send 12 B and receive 12 B. No averaging or hardware offload is implied. [ILLUSTRATIVE][DERIVED] [ANALYTICAL]
figures.alt_text: Four ranks start with vectors [1,2,-1,0], [2,4,-2,0], [3,6,-3,0], [4,8,-4,0]. Reduce-scatter leaves 10,20,-10,0 at ranks zero through three. All-gather gives [10,20,-10,0] to every rank. Directed ring order is zero to one to two to three to zero. Each rank sends twelve bytes and receives twelve bytes across both phases.

figures.caption: Collective semantics reach hardware through a framework backend, a collective implementation, and runtime/transport paths. Dashed setup paths can use MPI to distribute NCCL communicator IDs without carrying the collective payload. GPU-aware MPI is also a payload alternative, and legacy oneCCL can use MPI transport. Scope: conceptual paths with dated implementation examples; not a universal call graph or compatibility matrix. [1P][FACT] (named paths); [ILLUSTRATIVE] (composition)
figures.alt_text: Two solid downward paths connect ProcessGroupNCCL to NCCL, CUDA and GPU or network transport, then GPU and network hardware; and ProcessGroupXCCL to oneCCL, a SYCL Level Zero path and legacy MPI or OFI transport, then XPU and network hardware. Separate dashed setup arrows enter library initialization from launcher and rendezvous. A note states that GPU-aware MPI can also carry payload.
